## Where this roadmap stands

**At a glance.** Root systems have their axioms and bases; the classification has not begun.
Schur–Weyl duality has the double centralizer theorem and nothing of the duality itself.

### Roadmap coverage

In root systems, Layer 0 is done and Layer 1 has bases but not yet the integrality of roots in
them; Layer 2 is untouched. In Schur–Weyl duality, Lane A is done and Lane B is untouched.

## The frontier

- **Integrality of roots in a base** — every root is a combination of simple roots of one sign.
- **The Schur–Weyl duality** — needs the two commuting actions on the tensor power.
